noun_definition: lhn refers to the Left Hand Navigation menu that users interact with in the application, which is expected to be fully translated to Spanish when the language setting is changed.
Part refers to a section of the LHN (Left Hand Navigation) interface that is expected to be fully translated into Spanish when the language setting is changed on a secondary device.
Spanish refers to the language setting that is expected to fully translate the LHN (Left Hand Navigation) when selected on a secondary device.
Setting refers to the configuration option that allows a user to change the language preference on a secondary device.
Device refers to the hardware used to access the application, specifically distinguishing between the main device and the secondary device in the context of language settings for the LHN.
